Ramu Mutha vs The State Of Ap on 24 July, 2019
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu

entities.text: Ramu Mutha vs The State Of Ap
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioners/Accused 1 and 2 in FIR.No.401 of 2019 on the file of Gajuwaka Police Station,
Visakhapatnam.
The offences alleged are under Sections 273 and 188 IPC and Sections 59 (i) and 59 (ii) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
This Court has heard Sri R.Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor for respondent-State.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in a similar case, this Court, by virtue of common order in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein by considering that transportation of Gutka is not attracted by the offences alleged under Sections 188, 270 and 273 of IPC and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A perusal of the order shows that this Court, by considering that transportation of Gutka does not attract the offences alleged, quashed the proceedings.

Hence, following the said order and in terms thereof, the criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner-Accused 1 and 2 in FIR.No.401 of 2019 on the file of Gajuwaka Police Station, Visakhapatnam, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.

_ D.V.S.S.SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 24.07.2019 KLP Ramu Mutha vs The State Of Ap on 24 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128558342/
